Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 145. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
HP Cost: 5x HP
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 120 foot range (30 foot cube centered on
target)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: blast
The user channels their own life force into their
hands and fires it out as a square box.
Choose a location you can see within 80 feet. All
creatures in a 30 foot cube centered on that location
must make a dexterity saving throw, taking half damage
on a success.
This technique is fueled by life force directly dealing
1d10 ki damage for every 5 hp you put into it. This
health is drained immediately after the action is
concluded.
